description: This file defines a class 'Required' that extends 'AbstractRule' and implements a validation rule for required fields in the OrangeHRM system. It includes logic to validate whether an input is considered empty or not, with an option to exclude empty strings from being considered empty.

classes.name: Required
classes.description: Validation rule class to check if a given input is non-empty, with an option to exclude empty strings.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the excludeEmptyString property to determine if empty strings should be considered empty.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Performs validation to check if the input is considered present based on the excludeEmptyString flag.
